Lets a multimodal LLM look at the world through the Rider: camera image, room map, status, turning, driving.

docs.title: Movement rules
docs.text: Rule Detail Preconditions balancing, battery ≥ 20 %, not sleep mode (wake with ruhemodus), mode idle or manual (another mode is never interrupted; only stopp ends it) One movement at a time flock on /tmp/xgonav-mcp.lock; a second call fails at once End of every movement /drive?v=0&w=0, then /stop (mode idle), also on error, timeout (120 s) or client disconnect; xgonav stops by itself 0.5 s after the last setpoint fahren is always checked sicher=1: the setpoint passes safety() (fallen, blind, free space, TTC) and the arc check like the autonomous modes; manual_forward_gain is not applied, nominal speed ≈ v · robot.vx_limit; refused while blind or with the pipeline stopped drehen, rundblick unchecked turn on the spot (v = 0), ≤ 0.25 Limits v, w, duration and height are clamped in mcp.php; xgonav clamps to max_v/max_w and the speed slider on top

docs.title: Cost on the Pi
docs.text: When Cost No request none (php-fpm ondemand, no thread, nothing in xgonav) Per tool call one php-fpm request, 1–3 local HTTP requests to xgonav bild one JPEG in the web thread of xgonav (hardware encoder), not in the image pipeline karte one map render + PNG in the web thread During a movement /status + /drive at 10 Hz from one php-fpm worker (pool has 4) sicher=1 one safety() + arc check per control step while such a setpoint is active, as in every autonomous mode

docs.title: xgonav local API (xgonav/web.py)
docs.text:
Method Path Response / effect GET /status JSON (mode, pipeline, status, cmd, tracks, free, ttc, fps, loop_ms, loop_p95, loop_max, det_ms, grid, exposure, battery, balancing, state (firmware state, see driver.md), yaw_imu (heading in degrees from the IMU stream, all turns summed, not wrapped), height_mm, height_u8, cam_h_mm, cam_h_gerade [a, b] (mm = a + b·u8), pitch_src, pitch_deg, ego, odom, …); ?breakdown=1 adds per-section loop timing GET /ws WebSocket, overlay JPEGs; ?nick=2: per-frame IMU values in the header (ws_kopf, see Image transport) GET /frame?after=<idx> single JPEG newer than idx GET /startbild.jpg start image (anchor) as JPEG, encoded once per anchor; 404 without anchor GET /map.png?px=480&view=6[&cx=&cy=] room map; px 120..960, view 1..grid.size_m; centre cx,cy in map metres (both or neither; default Rider pose; clamped to ±grid.size_m); header X-Map-View: cx,cy,view,size; 404 if no map POST /mode?name=..&target=.. 400 unknown mode, 409 not allowed POST /stop standstill, mode idle; aborts a running firmware action 3..5 POST /action?n=3\|4\|5 firmware action that drives (3, 4) or turns (5): keepalive and kernel watchdog off for its duration ([robot] action_tick_s), every control step checks its current and upcoming segments with safety() and the arc check, any reduction aborts (128/128 every 20 ms until its planned end). 409: not mode idle, not balancing, sleep mode, action running; 3/4 also without image processing or floor boundary. A blocked path at start is reported in /status status only POST /pipeline?on=0\|1 stop/start image processing; 409 in sleep mode POST /ruhe?on=0\|1 sleep mode on/off; /status field ruhe POST /wlan?on=0\|1 start/cancel Wi-Fi setup (wifi-setup.md); /status field wlan (state, text, detail, ssid, ip, hotspot) or null. /status field ortung (sound direction, audio.md): aktiv, kern, fehler, n, schwach, letzter or null, verlauf (≤ 12 sounds of the last 15 s as [age s, angle °, quality, level dB]). Card Schallradar draws them as rays (up = front, dashed twin to the rear because front/back cannot be told apart, length = level, fading over 12 s; rays and spokes are counter-rotated by the IMU yaw since each sound, so they keep pointing at the source while the Rider turns; the card requests the IMU samples of the live packet itself, also with Lage closed); drawn in the browser only while the card is open, no extra request (data from the 1 s live packet) POST /record?on=0\|1 switch raw recording; /status field aufzeichnung: an, laeuft, ordner, bilder, fehler, frei_mb (free down to record_min_free_mb, statvfs at most every 2 s), rate_mb_s (measured in the last recording, else estimate 2.2), rate_gemessen; the web view shows free space and remaining minutes left of the button POST /level leveling pulse (roll 0, 3 s roll_balance); 409 if not balancing POST /drive?v=..&w=..[&sicher=1] 409 if not mode manual; sicher=1 (used by the MCP server): this setpoint passes safety() and the arc check like the autonomous modes, without manual_forward_gain; with the pipeline stopped it only turns POST /exposure?us=.., /gain?g=.. 400 if out of range POST /bild?k=0.5..4&s=0.5..4&b=-0.5..0.5 contrast/saturation/brightness in the camera ISP (b optional; also reaches FloorNet and recordings; meta.jsonl cam.contrast/saturation/brightness), until restart; /status exposure.contrast/saturation/brightness; the web view can compensate with an SVG filter (checkbox, stored in the browser). Camera sliders (exposure, gain, brightness, contrast, saturation, hue) sit in a collapsible „Kamera“ panel below the image (open state stored in the browser); hue is display-only (SVG filter) POST /tempo?f=0.05..1 speed slider: factor for all drive/turn commands of all modes (after max_v/max_w), until restart; GET /status → tempo POST /map/reset clear room map, pose = start = 0 POST /map/start start point = current pose POST /map/save save now to grid.file; 404 if no map or no file POST /map/pose?aktion=start\|hier\|verwerfen start: Rider stands on the start point, pose jumps there; hier: shown pose is right; verwerfen: pose unknown (needs [reloc] enabled). 409 while lying, during home/patrol/explore GET /detector selectable targets (detector classes), computed on request only GET /floornet *.bin in [freespace] net_dir, active (symlink net) and loaded net; one directory read on request POST /floornet?name=x.bin switch floor model without restart: load + self-test in the web thread (old net keeps running), then repoint symlink net atomically, swap the net in FreeSpaceWorker (waits for a running inference), close the old one, floor boundary held restart_hold_s. Only in idle/manual (409), 409 if not loadable (old net stays), 400 for names outside net_dir, 500 if the symlink cannot be written

Removed 2026-11-17: /stream (MJPEG), /ws?nick=1, /horizon, /horizon/edit, /horizon/cal, /horizon/delete and api.php?a=horizon|horizon_edit|horizon_cal|horizon_delete; /status has no horizon field any more, pitch_src is "imu" or "bild".

docs.title: Image transport (WebSocket)
docs.text:
Item Value Path /ws (nginx → xgonav /ws, TLS terminates in nginx) Message binary: 4-byte frame index + JPEG; with ?nick=2 (used by index.php, header from web.ws_kopf): index, then 10 × float32 BE: row_stand, row_imu (horizon_row(0) / horizon_row(pure IMU pitch); NaN = no IMU), roll (deg, + = right side low, as the cyan line), cx, IMU pitch (deg), IMU heading (deg), age of the IMU sample (ms), pitch rate from image and from IMU (°/s), state (1 = IMU valid, 0 = pitch from the image only, NaN = no IMU); then the JPEG. All from the snapshot, nothing computed anew Flow control client sends ok per image; xgonav sends the next (newest) image only after ack Ack timeout 10 s → connection closed Reconnect client after 1 s Pipeline state client connects only while pipeline = läuft (and not sleep mode), closes otherwise; last image stays dimmed. xgonav sends an unchanged image once, no re-encode Rate ≤ output.web_fps (10) Overlay no status text lines in web frames (~10 ms saved per image); drawing ~1 ms per sent image (RiderPi) JPEG hardware encoder /dev/video31 (jpeg.py, native/jpegfast.cpp, output.jpeg_native), self-check at first image; fallback cv2.imencode (4.5 ms CPU per 640×480 image on the RiderPi); raw recording see below

Replaced MJPEG (/stream, removed 2026-11-17): on weak Wi-Fi, TCP buffers queued up to 20 s of delay.

docs.title: Live data (WebSocket)
docs.text:
Daemon tools/live.php (PHP CLI, unit xgonav-live.service, user www-data, Nice=10), not under web/ (would be callable via php-fpm). Reads /proc directly, works without xgonav. One shared read per tick for all tabs.

Item Value Path /live (nginx → 127.0.0.1:8089) Idle no client: blocks in stream_select, no /proc reads, 0 % CPU sys + status, 1 s (sleep mode 5 s) sys: t, cpu [[total, idle+iowait], …] per core (jiffies), temp_c, load, mhz [cur, max] (cpu0 cpufreq) or null, battery, height, roll, state, wlan "rx_bytes tx_bytes dBm quality" (- = unknown); status: xgonav /status verbatim (timeout 0.5 s) or null + status_fehler imu, 0.3 s if state = 1 (balancing), else 1 s; none in sleep mode seq, imu [[seq, t_ms, roll, pitch, yaw], …] (°), wseq, wheels [[seq, t_ms, ticks_left, ticks_right], …], state; only samples newer than the last sent per connection Packing sys and imu due together → one text frame {"sys":…,"status":…,"imu":…} Client → server imu 0\|1 [since wsince]: IMU on/off for this connection (Lage closed or tab hidden → 0); since/wsince after reconnect avoid duplicates Reconnect client after 1 s Limit imu_log holds 128 samples: at 1 s while lying, samples are skipped Env (tests) XGO_PROC, XGO_LIVE_PORT, XGO_STATUS_URL

Collapsible card Telefon right below the camera image (closed by default, localStorage xgonav.telefon), button Sprechen; the heading shows the state. Daemon tools/sprech.php (PHP CLI, unit xgonav-sprech.service, user www-data + group audio, Nice=10); WebSocket helpers shared with live.php in tools/ws.inc.php.

Item Value Path /sprech (nginx → 127.0.0.1:8090) Rider → browser arecord -D plughw:0,0 -f S16_LE -r 8000 -c 1, binary frames of 640 B (40 ms); dropped while > 0.5 s unsent Browser → Rider binary frames S16_LE 8 kHz mono → aplay -D plughw:0,0; backlog > 0.5 s cut to the newest 0.2 s Server → client (text) {"sprech": "an"\|"aus", "grund": …}, then close Client → server (text) mic 0\|1 (send Rider microphone), laut 0\|1 (speaker) Admission xgonav /status mode == "manual" and not sleep mode; one call at a time (second browser: busy) End browser closes, mode leaves manual or xgonav unreachable (checked every 1 s), arecord/aplay ends; then both processes are killed, hw:0,0 free for sound direction (retry ≤ [ortung] retry_s 10 s) Idle no call: no arecord/aplay, blocks in stream_select, 0 % CPU Browser getUserMedia (echo cancellation, noise suppression, AGC; needs HTTPS), AudioWorklet: 3.5 kHz low-pass (windowed sinc, Blackman, 127 taps, evaluated only at the 8 kHz output points; until 2026-11-21 a box filter that folded 4–24 kHz into the voice band) + decimation to 8 kHz, 400 Hz high-pass (Butterworth 4th order; the Rider speaker produces almost only harmonics below ~300 Hz: measured +16 dB at 150 Hz, +7 dB at 250 Hz over the fundamental), then gain to the Rider 100–1600 % (default 300 %, localStorage xgonav.sprechhin2) with a soft tanh limiter up to 0.9 (speaker measurements with the old class-D boost 4, which itself distorted; now boost 0, docs/audio.md); playback with 120 ms jitter buffer (> 0.4 s → cut to 0.12 s), linear upsampling, volume here 0–400 % (localStorage xgonav.sprechlaut) Echo the Rider's speaker reaches its own microphones (−17 dBFS), our voice returns after the round trip (~0.5–1.5 s: Wi-Fi, aplay/arecord buffers, jitter buffer). Browser-side echo gate: level envelopes of sent and received audio in 40 ms bins, every 1 s the best log-level correlation over 0–1.6 s delay votes into a decaying histogram, coupling = median received/sent. A Rider frame is cut to 5 % when we spoke loudly within ±240 ms of the estimated delay and it is not clearly louder (3×) than the expected echo (double talk passes); without an estimate the whole 0–1.7 s window after own speech. Until 2026-11-21 it dimmed only 300 ms after own speech, so most of the echo came through. Simulated only (echo_sim), not heard. Option Drücken zum Sprechen (talk button or space bar; Rider dimmed while held; localStorage xgonav.sprechptt) Cost on the Pi arecord + aplay (8 kHz mono, ALSA plug resampling) + PHP loop ≈ 25 wake-ups/s: ≲ 1 % of a core, only during a call; Wi-Fi 2 × 16 kB/s; nothing in xgonav Limits during a call other aplay sounds (web, rc.local) fail (device busy) Camera → display checkbox Kamera senden (only during a call), 5 (default)/10/15 frames/s (localStorage xgonav.sprechfps), mirrored preview; second WebSocket /sprech?bild (own TCP connection, audio not held up) Display frame browser crops to 320×240 (centre, unmirrored), converts to RGB565 LE, one binary frame of 153 600 B; sends only with bufferedAmount 0; other lengths dropped Display write PID into /tmp/lcd0.owner, wait 0.3 s (emotion player / lcd.py release the FIFO), open FIFO r+ non-blocking, partial writes kept so frames stay whole; one frame in flight + newest waiting; owner touched per frame Emotion meanwhile foreign PID in owner: current frame finished, FIFO closed, frames dropped until owner empty, then taken over again Display end image socket closes or call ends: rest written (≤ 1 s), FIFO closed, owner cleared, emotion cute played Server → client (image) {"bild": "an"\|"aus", "grund": …}; refused without call, second image busy, no FIFO Cost on the Pi (image) raw frames, no decoding. Measured 2026-11-21 (% of a core): 5/s nginx 4.9, PHP 3.3, st7789_server 1.0 (≈ 9 %, Wi-Fi 0.75 MB/s); 10/s nginx 9.0, PHP 5.7, st7789_server 2.2 (≈ 17 %, 1.5 MB/s); nothing in xgonav Env (tests) XGO_SPRECH_PORT, XGO_STATUS_URL, XGO_ARECORD, XGO_APLAY (full command lines), XGO_LCD_FIFO, XGO_LCD_ENDE

docs.title: Pipeline stop
docs.text: POST /pipeline?on=0: camera stopped, no image processing, standstill, mode idle. CM4 CPU of the service ~340 % → ~4 %. Web stays reachable. After start: drives only once a mode is chosen. With full processing, the charging dock current is insufficient to charge.

docs.title: Sleep mode (Ruhe)
docs.text:
Header button Ruhe (with confirmation). Woken by Wecken in the web UI or by the MCP server (ruhemodus).

Part On Wake Rider set down (action 254) if balancing stays lying xgonav pipeline off, mode idle, raw recording off; imu, wheels threads idle; robot thread reads state/battery every ruhe.tick_s (1 s), no keepalive; no LCD, no emotions, no WebSocket re-encode; pipeline and modes other than idle → 409 threads resume; pipeline stays off Driver (settings/) imu_hz, imu_stream_hz → 0, sleep_ms_on_loop → ruhe.sleep_ms_on_loop (1000); old values kept in memory old values written back CPU (xgo-ruhe, root) governor saved to /run/xgo-ruhe.gov, all cores powersave saved governor (fallback ondemand) Wi-Fi (xgo-ruhe, root) iw dev wlan0 set power_save on power_save off (also default via /etc/NetworkManager/conf.d/xgonav-wifi-powersave.conf; with power save ping 535 ms avg / 1.5 s max, without 20 ms, 2026-11-18) Display (api.php) plays sleep (~4 s, before the governor change); last frame (closed eyes) stays unchanged until xgonav or an emotion writes the next frame Page cover with Wecken + battery; image WebSocket closed, no map polling; live packet every 5 s without IMU normal rates
  • The display stays on: it cannot be switched off (DISPOFF + SLPIN via SIGUSR1 to st7789_server is no longer sent; xgo-ruhe off still sends SIGUSR2). Backlight (GPIO0 per constants.h) is not switched; untested.
  • POST ?a=ruhe&on=1 returns after the animation (~4 s).
  • The ESP32 keeps running (control loop, BLE, amber LEDs).
  • If xgonav restarts during sleep mode, the governor stays powersave until Ruhe + Wecken.
  • If NetworkManager reconnects during sleep mode, Wi-Fi power save is off again (NM setting).

docs.title: Raw recording (xgonav/rawrec.py)
docs.text: Item Value Writes JPEG (quality 92) + meta.jsonl per frame, format for tools/replay_raw.py and tools/floornet/ Target output.record_dir/YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS (default ~/fahrt, as service user) JPEG hardware encoder q95 (output.record_jpeg_q_hw), fallback libjpeg q92; meta.jsonl "jpeg" per image (since 2026-11-19) Condition switch on, state = balancing, pipeline running; only frames newer than the start Set down closes the recording; switch stays on, next stand-up starts a new subdirectory, no empty directories Off by itself service restart; free space < output.record_min_free_mb or write error (reason shown next to the button) Cost on the Pi off: no thread. On, lying: 5 attribute reads/s. Recording: one JPEG per frame in its own thread on render_cpus, never in the main loop; frames are skipped if it falls behind (gaps in idx)

docs.title: Overlay colours
docs.text: Colour Meaning magenta floor boundary from FloorNet, mapped onto the shown frame cyan horizon from the IMU pitch of the frame (rolled by the IMU roll) bottom bars free space per sector red target track violet image motion blue drive command

docs.title: Route, no-go zones, patrol
docs.text:
Control Effect Route setzen click points on the map, optional loop, POST api.php?a=route&pts=x,y;x,y&loop=0\|1 Sperrzone click at least 3 corners, added to the existing zones (zones=x,y;x,y;x,y\|...) Zonen löschen nozones=1 Karte sperren POST api.php?a=map_lock&on=0\|1 Streife mode patrol after a confirmation dialog (bestaetigt=1)

Coordinates are metres in the map frame (top = +x, left = +y). GET api.php?a=route returns points, loop, zones, map_id.

docs.title: Wi-Fi setup without a network
docs.text: Two ways in, no existing connection needed: the automatic hotspot RiderKerk and the buttons C+D (Wi-Fi QR code to the camera). Bluetooth: ble.md. Code: root part deploy/xgo-wlan (NetworkManager), service deploy/xgo-wlan-auto.service, buttons xgonav/wlan.py, web form web/wlan.php. Automatic hotspot since 2026-11-21, not yet tested on the Rider.

docs.title: Automatic hotspot
docs.text: Item Value Trigger wlan0 not connected for 60 s (/sys/class/net/wlan0/operstate ≠ up): after boot without a reachable or configured network, or after a lost connection Network SSID RiderKerk, open (no password), 2.4 GHz, NetworkManager profile xgo-hotspot (autoconnect off), Rider at 10.42.0.1 Join phone into RiderKerk, open https://10.42.0.1/wlan.php (self-signed TLS warning), pick network, enter password Connect fails hotspot back after about a minute; join again, wlan.php shows the error (status field letzt) Back to known networks every 5 min, only if a Wi-Fi profile exists and no device is joined: hotspot closed, brcmfmac reloaded, NetworkManager tries known networks (≤ 45 s), else hotspot again No profile at all hotspot stays Independent of xgonav (service runs as root, After=NetworkManager.service) Security open network: anyone in range reaches the web interface, MCP and driving while the hotspot is up Display xgonav shows Hotspot RiderKerk: 10.42.0.1/wlan.php only in the C+D screen; otherwise nothing

docs.title: Buttons C+D
docs.text:
Step Action Display 1 Hold C+D for 3 s (in sleep mode up to ~5 s) eyes looking around with QR finder patterns as pupils (QrEyes, CM4 ~4.7 ms per frame at 20 fps ≈ 9 % of one core, only while searching), small camera image top left, Wi-Fi symbol with 60 s countdown ring (red for the last 10 s), "WLAN-QR vor die Kamera halten"; hotspot address if the automatic hotspot is up 2 Show a Wi-Fi QR code to the camera (Android: Wi-Fi → Share; iOS: Wi-Fi → (i) → share / Passwords app) "Verbinde mit …", then "Verbunden: " + IP (20 s) or the error (8 s, then back to 1) 3 No code within 60 s "Kein WLAN-Code", setup ends (no hotspot from here since 2026-11-21) Cancel press B, hold C+D again, or POST /wlan?on=0 setup ends

Also reachable from the web: api.php?a=wlan&on=1; wlan.php works in normal operation as "add Wi-Fi".

docs.title: Behaviour
docs.text: Item Value Trigger /proc/XGORider/buttons (read by the robot thread anyway), [wlan] buttons = 12 held hold_s = 3; cancel cancel_buttons = 2 (B). A+B is shutdown in the driver During setup sleep mode ended, mode idle, robot.stop() (a balancing Rider stays standing), camera on, _step does not run After camera returns to its previous state, mode idle QR WeChat QR (opencv-contrib) if qr_model_dir exists, else cv2.QRCodeDetector on full frame, else 2× centre crop; ≤ qr_hz = 5; format WIFI:T:..;S:..;P:..;H:..;; with escapes, any order; WPA or open (WEP rejected) Profile keyfile /etc/NetworkManager/system-connections/xgo-wlan-<uuid>.nmconnection (0600), name xgo-<ssid>, autoconnect-priority = 10, ipv4.may-fail = false (no IPv4 = failure); password never on a command line; same-name xgo- profile replaced, others never deleted Failure new profile deleted, previous connection (or the hotspot) brought back Locking flock /run/xgo-wlan.lock: connect/hotspot/hotspot-off wait (≤ 90 s), an automatic step is skipped while one runs Leaving the hotspot brcmfmac reloaded (chip_reset, ~5 s) before reconnecting. Without it (measured 2026-11-19): frames to the Rider with WMM priority Voice are lost until reboot; NetworkManager's DHCPv4 uses TOS 0xc0, the router offers, nothing arrives → IPv6 only, unreachable via IPv4 Files /run/xgo-wlan.hotspot (hotspot up), /run/xgo-wlan.prev (previous connection), /run/xgo-wlan.letzt (last failed connect from the hotspot)

docs.title: Cost on the Pi
docs.text: State Cost Connected xgo-wlan auto: one shell read from /sys and one sleep every 10 s; no nmcli, no D-Bus Hotspot additionally nmcli con show + iw station dump every 5 min; a return attempt costs ~5 s chip reset and up to 45 s without hotspot C+D setup pipeline paused; QR decode ≤ 5 Hz; LCD image only on change; one xgo-wlan status at start

docs.title: Config [wlan]
docs.text:
Key Default enabled true buttons, hold_s, cancel_buttons 12, 3.0, 2 qr_hz, qr_timeout_s 5.0, 60.0 qr_model_dir models/wechat_qr helper /usr/local/sbin/xgo-wlan

hotspot_ssid and hotspot_timeout_s are gone (warning when still in config.toml). Hotspot timings are constants in deploy/xgo-wlan (TAKT 10 s, FRIST 60 s, RUECK 300 s).

docs.title: Vendor background
docs.text: Source Method ESP32 firmware (xgorider2_rl) BLE is only a UART channel (fff0/fff1/fff2) for the remote app; no Wi-Fi provisioning, nothing forwarded to the Pi. Replaced by firmware patch 0025: own BLE service with a tunnel to the Pi, wlan status/scan/rescan/connect over Bluetooth with the same xgo-wlan (ble.md) Vendor Pi image (RaspberryPi-CM4-XGO-Rider) display menu: demos/network.py (QR via pyzbar, overwrites wpa_supplicant.conf), hotspot.py (nmcli hotspot)

docs.title: Behaviours
docs.text: A mode is picked in the web UI (mode bar) or with --mode on the command line. Every mode except manual needs a running pipeline and a working FloorNet; without it the Rider is blind and stands still.

docs.title: Modes
docs.text:
Mode (web, EN / DE) --mode What it does Driven on the Rider Idle idle watches only, no driving; sound direction active yes Manual / Hand manual D-pad / keys; skips floor model and path check, fall detection and watchdogs stay yes Follow / Folgen follow follows the chosen target class (person by default) at a set distance yes (2026-11-02, max_v 0.10–0.15) Approach / Anfahren approach searches the target class, drives to ~0.55 m in front and stops no, simulator only Explore / Erkunden explore maps the room: full turn, then drives to the borders between known floor and unknown (frontiers), returns to the start three runs 2026-11-06, map not usable yet; no fall protection Home / Zum Start home plans a path over the room map back to the start point; at the end measures the pose against the start image yes (2026-11-19: end ~1 cm from start) Patrol / Streife patrol drives the route drawn on the room map, lap after lap; back to start at 30 % battery no Pet / Haustier pet reacts to people, cats and dogs with eyes, sounds and gestures; can search, roam and listen no, simulator and unit tests only

Details: Odometry and maps (explore, home, patrol), Display and emotions (pet), Limitations.

Stairs

The floor model sees a step too late. explore, approach, patrol and pet with driving enabled must never run near stairs or edges.

docs.title: Safety layers
docs.text:
Every drive command passes these layers; the last one has the final word.

Layer Effect safety() not balancing → stop; blind → stop; little free space ahead → slow down / no forward; time-to-contact < 0.8 s → no forward Path check (_arc_check) planned arc (forward and reverse) against the local map Robot clamp to max_v / max_w, ramp, keepalive, userspace watchdog 0.5 s Kernel watchdog motion_timeout_ms 1000: stops if xgonav stops writing

Detections (YOLO) are only targets, never obstacles: obstacles come from FloorNet alone.

docs.title: Follow
docs.text: Item Value Target class from the dropdown (GET /detector); detector runs only in follow, approach, pet Distance from the foot point of the box and the camera geometry Lost target, with room map and confirmed pose planner drives to the last known position (pose + distance + bearing at last sighting), there turns 360° (lost_look_deg), then waits; target back in view ends the search. Simulator only Lost target, otherwise turns towards the side it was last seen, waits after search_timeout_s

docs.title: Explore → Home → Patrol
docs.text:
Explore (map the room) → map locked → draw route + no-go zones → Patrol (drive the route) → Home
Step Note Explore ends when nothing reachable is left, saves the map and drives to the start Map lock set after explore; drives no longer change the map Patrol start only standing at the start point (confirmation dialog), battery ≥ 40 % Home arrives at the map start; the start image check corrects the pose at the end

docs.title: Pet
docs.text:
Situation Reaction person far / near / very near notices, turns towards, cute, shy trusted person walks away (follow_trust) follows like follow (same servo), stops when close person gone searches the last position (planner), looks around, then listens; sound only counts after that nobody for 30 s roams (looks around, short legs) sound from the side turns towards it and listens; calling makes it come dog close whimpers, ducks; optional faint (sets down, stands up again by itself)

Defaults stay on the spot unless driving budgets are set ([pet] seek_m, roam_m, call_m). retreat_m, creep_m and faint only with someone watching, never near stairs.

docs.title: Install
docs.text: Target: Raspberry Pi OS Bookworm 64-bit on the RiderPi CM4, kernel 6.6.74. All commands run on the Rider from the repo root unless marked PC. Full reference: Installation.

docs.title: 1. Prepare
docs.text:
Step Command Pin the kernel (6.12 breaks the sound driver, xgo-drv untested there) sudo cp deploy/apt-pin-kernel /etc/apt/preferences.d/xgonav-kernel Kernel headers sudo apt install linux-headers-$(uname -r) Copy the repo to the Rider (PC) scp -r xgo_motorcortex2 root@<rider>:/home/ or git clone on the Rider TLS certificate for the web UI /etc/xgonav/tls/fullchain.crt + privkey.key (without them nginx stays off)

Windows clones

With core.autocrlf=true, shell scripts may arrive with CRLF and fail at boot. .gitattributes forces LF; check copied scripts with file.

docs.title: 2. Install everything
docs.text:
sudo ./deploy/install-all.sh            # driver, display, rc.local, xgonav -> /opt/xgonav, nginx + php-fpm
sudo reboot                             # driver and rc.local take effect after reboot
Option Skips --no-driver kernel module --no-display LCD daemon --no-web nginx, php-fpm, sudoers, xgonav-live, xgonav-sprech

install-all.sh backs up every changed file in /etc as *.bak-<timestamp> and does not start xgonav.

docs.title: 3. What gets built
docs.text: Part Built by Without it xgo-drv make -C kernel_module no hardware access C++ core libxgofast.so make -C /opt/xgonav/xgonav/native (in install.sh) no FloorNet = blind, Rider does not drive by itself Camera library libxgocam.so make -C /opt/xgonav/xgonav/native cam falls back to picamera2. Rebuild after every apt upgrade st7789_server make -C st7789/project/riderpi no eyes on the LCD

docs.title: 4. Models
docs.text:
Model Where it comes from FloorNet models/floornet.bin in the repo; install.sh copies it to /opt/xgonav/models/floornet/ YOLO (follow, approach, pet) export on the PC/GPU machine only: ./tools/export_model.sh yolo11n 256, then scp -r models/yolo11n_256_ncnn models/yolo11n_256.onnx root@<rider>:/opt/xgonav/models/

Without YOLO the detector is off (warning in the log); manual driving, explore and home still work.

docs.title: 5. Start
docs.text:
sudo systemctl enable --now xgonav      # as a service (user aeinstein, group video)
journalctl -u xgonav -f                 # log (German)

Open https://<rider>/. No authentication: LAN only.

docs.title: 6. Check
docs.text:
Check Expect cat /proc/XGORider/serial_stats counters rising, few errors cat /proc/XGORider/imu roll/pitch/yaw change when you tilt the Rider log after start [floornet] … geladen, Selbstprüfung …; no [floornet] … aus web header battery, state, pipeline shown

After apt upgrade: check imports as the service user, the service uses ~/.local (OpenCV 4.10, numpy 1.26): sudo -u aeinstein /opt/xgonav/venv/bin/python -c "import cv2, numpy, picamera2".

docs.title: Update
docs.text:
git pull && sudo ./deploy/install.sh && sudo systemctl restart xgonav

Do not rebuild .so files while xgonav runs unless the build replaces them atomically (.tmp + mv, default since d4f0943).

docs.title: On the Rider (web UI)
docs.text:
Before the first drive

Clear floor, no stairs or edges nearby, someone watching. Body height never below minimum + 10 mm. STOP (header, top right) stops everything and switches to idle.

# Do Where 1 Switch the Rider on, wait for the eyes on the LCD 2 Open https://<rider>/ browser in the same LAN 3 Start vision (camera, FloorNet); from sleep mode first Wake Vision card → Start 4 Stand up Attitude card → Stand up (action 255); wait until the state shows balancing 5 Drive by hand hold the D-pad in the image, arrow keys or WASD; mode switches to Manual 6 Try a mode mode bar: Follow (pick a target class), Explore, Home, Pet 7 Set down Attitude → Sit down (action 254) 8 Save battery Vision → Stop, or Rest in the header (sleep mode)

The UI is German by default; EN in the header switches the labels to English (used throughout this manual).

docs.title: On the Rider (command line)
docs.text:
cd /opt/xgonav
venv/bin/python -m xgonav --config config.toml --mode idle                      # watch only
venv/bin/python -m xgonav --config config.toml --mode idle --record debug.mp4   # record the overlay
venv/bin/python -m xgonav --config config.toml --mode follow                    # follow a person
python tools/nudge.py turn 20                                                   # turn 20° left (IMU-controlled)

Stop the service first (sudo systemctl stop xgonav); only one xgonav may own the camera.

docs.title: On the PC (no hardware)
docs.text:
python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install "opencv-python-headless>=4.6" "numpy>=1.24" pytest "onnxruntime>=1.16"
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/                              # unit tests, ~2 s
.venv/bin/python tests/sim_run.py follow 40 out.mp4               # simulator, overlay video
.venv/bin/python tests/sim_run.py explore 300 --wheels --fs-thread --dyn --rider

On Windows use .venv\Scripts\python. More: Simulator and tests.

docs.title: Web UI
docs.text: https://<rider>/ – nginx + PHP on the Rider, live data over WebSockets. Everything shown here is drawn in the browser; the Rider only sends JPEG frames and status. The UI is German by default, EN in the header switches it; the screenshots show the English labels with the German ones in brackets. Full reference with every control: Web interface.

docs.title: Header
docs.text: Item Meaning Pills connection, mode, state (balancing / lying), battery (green ≥ 40 %, yellow ≥ 20 %, red below), vision (pipeline), recording, Wi-Fi (dBm, ↓/↑ kB/s) DE / EN UI language (browser only) Manual (Anleitung) this manual Diagram (Schaubild) diagram of the image pipeline Settings (Einstellungen) all parameters of config.toml, with backup and restart Shut down (Herunterfahren) shut the Pi down (confirm) Rest (Ruhe) sleep mode: set down, pipeline off, CPU clock down, sleeping eyes; only Wake (Wecken) ends it STOP standstill, mode idle

docs.title: Camera
docs.text: Item Meaning Image live camera with overlay: magenta = floor boundary (FloorNet), cyan = horizon from IMU pitch, bars at the bottom = free space per sector, blue = drive command, dashed line = image centre D-pad hold to drive by hand (also arrow keys / WASD); switches to Manual Camera bar exposure, gain (auto or fixed), brightness / contrast / saturation (ISP: also affects FloorNet and recordings), hue (browser only) Checkboxes Pin image to IMU pitch, Level roll, Image centre: done in the browser by CSS, no cost on the Pi Speed scales every drive command of all modes IMU line IMU values of the shown frame (pitch, roll, heading, age)

docs.title: Mode, floor model, vision
docs.text: Item Meaning Mode bar Idle · Manual · Follow · Explore · Home · Patrol · Pet · Approach, see Behaviours Target class for Follow / Approach (from the YOLO model) Floor model (Bodenmodell) pick a FloorNet from models/floornet/, Activate switches without restart (idle / manual only) Vision (Bildverarbeitung) start / stop camera and image processing; free space for recordings; status tiles (fps, loop time, FloorNet ms) Record (Aufzeichnen) raw recording (JPEG + meta.jsonl) while balancing, input for FloorNet training

docs.title: Attitude (Lage)
docs.text: Item Meaning 3D model CAD model rotated by IMU roll, pitch, yaw; wheels turn with the encoders; drag to orbit, double-click resets Camera height vertical slider: body height, shown as camera height in mm Roll roll setpoint −20..20° Stand up / Jump up action 255 / 253 Re-level levelling pulse after standing up Sit down set down (254) ESP restart restart the ESP32 (only while lying)

docs.title: Sound radar (Schallradar)
docs.text: Direction of sound from the two microphones (modes idle, pet): ray = sound, length = loudness, fades in 12 s. Rays turn with the Rider (IMU yaw), so they keep pointing at the source. Front and back cannot be told apart. Reference: Audio.

docs.title: Extras
docs.text: Firmware actions 1–6, the four LEDs (colour pickers, all off, strobe), LED brightness (persistent), display emotions.

docs.title: Room map (Raumkarte)
docs.text:
Item Meaning Map occupancy grid (grey unknown, light free, dark occupied, green path, cyan plan, blue start, red Rider); drag to pan, wheel to zoom, double-click follows the Rider View 3 / 6 / 10 / 16 / 24 m Map Save, Lock map, Reset Start · Pose Start here (set the start point), discard pose Route · Zones Set route (click patrol points), No-go zone, Delete zones

No-go zones drift with the pose: no replacement for a physical barrier.

docs.title: History (Verlauf)
docs.text: CPU load per core with temperature and clock, Wi-Fi throughput and signal, battery over 2 h (stored in the browser).

docs.title: Settings (Einstellungen)
docs.text: Every parameter of Configuration, grouped as Hardware · Wahrnehmung (perception) · Karten (maps) · Verhalten (behaviour) · Ausgabe (output); help text comes from the code (German). Search by key or text, only set in config.toml filters. Only changed lines are written, a backup is made before every save (Backups restores one), Default removes a line. Takes effect after Save and restart.

docs.title: Pipeline diagram (Schaubild)
docs.text: Static page: stages, threads, C++ / Python parts, inputs and consumers of the image pipeline.

docs.title: Calibration
docs.text:
Defaults in xgonav/config.py are the values of one RiderPi. Another unit needs at least the steps below. Run on the Rider in /opt/xgonav, write results into config.toml (or via Einstellungen). Order matters. Full procedure: Calibration.

# What Key How 0 horizontal FOV [camera] hfov_deg turn ≥ 360° on the spot, compare image rotation with IMU heading 1 turn direction and scale [robot] vyaw_limit_dps python tools/calibrate.py turn 2 camera height and tilt [camera] mount_offset_mm, tilt_deg, [imu] pitch_ref_deg floor grid / folding rule 3 IMU time offset and sign [imu] time_offset_ms, pitch_sign fixed on the RiderPi; Config.neutral() = automatic 4 wheel odometry [odom] scale_left, scale_right, track_m tape measure, full turns 5 drive gains [robot] reverse_gain, manual_forward_gain

Positioning helpers (balancing Rider): python tools/nudge.py turn <deg>, python tools/nudge.py move <s>.

Leg calibration is locked

Saving leg zero points with slack legs overwrote them in the ESP32 flash once. The web buttons are disabled; see Calibration.

docs.title: Kernel driver xgo-drv
docs.text:
Item Value Source kernel_module/ (upstream aeinstein/xgo_motorcortex + patches) Build make -C kernel_module on the Rider (kernel headers) Interface /proc/XGORider/*: drive, height, action, IMU, imu_log, wheels, LEDs, settings Test without hardware driver-test/run.sh kernel_module 6 50 --wheels --combo --faults (driver code in userspace against an ESP32 emulator) Reload sudo rmmod xgo-drv; sudo modprobe xgo-drv

Update order: xgonav first, then the driver. Reference: Driver.

docs.title: ESP32 firmware
docs.text:

Flashing

Only the app partition app0 at 0x10000. Never write 0x310000–0x32ffff (leg zero points, BLE name, pitch trim) or spiffs.

LED colours and patterns: LEDs.

docs.title: FloorNet training
docs.text: FloorNet is the self-trained network that finds the floor boundary (one row per 8 px column). It is the only floor boundary: without it the Rider is blind. Runs on the Rider in C++ with NEON (~14 ms per frame); training runs on a GPU machine. Full reference: FloorNet.

docs.title: Pipeline
docs.text: # Step Where 1 raw recording Rider (web UI) 2 frame list, ComfyUI paints the floor green (stage 1) GPU machine 3 mask (stage 2), floor from the bottom (stage 3) GPU machine 4 review in the viewer, mark bad frames browser 5 labels, training, export to .bin GPU machine 6 copy to models/floornet/, pick in the web UI Rider

docs.title: 1. Record
docs.text: Web UI → Pipeline → Aufzeichnen, then drive by hand. Writes JPEG + meta.jsonl (pose, IMU, wheels, height, camera settings) per frame to ~/fahrt/YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS while balancing; setting down closes the run. Drive slowly, vary distance to walls, furniture and rugs, bright and dark rooms.

docs.title: 2. Labels (GPU machine)
docs.text:
python tools/floornet/ids_fahrt.py 20261110-201720 --jedes 2 >> comfy/ids.txt     # frame list, standing frames dropped
python tools/floornet/comfy_batch.py --prompt tools/floornet/comfy_prompt11.txt --ids comfy/ids.txt \
    --edits stage1_p11 --nur_edits --eingang auto --out stage1_p11                # Qwen-Image-Edit paints the floor #00FF00
python tools/floornet/stage2.py stage1_p11 stage2_p11 --steht_m 0.03 --steht_grad 3  # green lead ≥ 30 → mask
python tools/floornet/stage3.py stage2_p11 stage3_p11                              # per column: floor unbroken from the bottom
Stage Content 1 ComfyUI edit (bright frames in colour, dark frames as G0h); edits are kept forever, seed fixed 2 binary mask from hue, saturation, green lead 3 per pixel column only the floor connected to the bottom edge: no islands, no holes

Prompt rules that matter: never name what should not appear (the model paints it), rugs are obstacles, floor under furniture only where an 18 cm Rider fits.

docs.title: 3. Review
docs.text: tools/floornet/betrachter.html (served by betrachter_server.py, port 8765, home network only) shows original, stage 1–3 side by side. Arrow keys step, X marks a frame unusable, A shows sorted-out frames. Only reviewed runs go into training.

docs.title: 4. Train and export
docs.text:
python tools/floornet/stage3_npz.py stage3_p11 --config rider.toml --out stage3_p11_labels
python tools/floornet/train.py --labels stage3_p11_labels --out lauf/ --train <runs> --val <runs>
python tools/floornet/export.py lauf/floornet.pt --out models/floornet/<name>.bin

Training takes about a minute on the GPU. Keep check runs (never trained) apart: a run in training cannot test the same network. Measure with tools/floornet/eval_labels.py.

docs.title: 5. Deploy
docs.text:
scp models/floornet/<name>.bin root@<rider>:/opt/xgonav/models/floornet/

Web UI → Bodenmodell → pick → Aktivieren (idle / manual only, no restart). models/floornet.bin on the Rider is a symlink: never cp onto it. The net runs a self-test at load; on failure the Rider is blind and says so in the log.

docs.title: C++ core
docs.text:
Everything that runs per frame on the CM4 is C++ (xgonav/native/), loaded by ctypes in xgonav/fastlib.py. Python only wires it together. Each function group has an ABI number and, where possible, a bit-identical Python path for tests.

Library / file Content libxgofast.so egofast.cpp (ego-motion), floornet.cpp (FloorNet, NEON), gridfast.cpp (room map), navfast.cpp (A*, frontier, local map, path check), linsefast.cpp (undistortion), jpegfast.cpp (hardware JPEG), ortfast.cpp (sound direction), stimmfast.cpp (voice samples) libxgocam.so camfast.cpp: libcamera directly, undistorts from the DMA buffer 
make -C xgonav/native        # on the Rider (libopencv-dev)
make -C xgonav/native cam    # camera library (libcamera-dev); rebuild after apt upgrade
Rule Why change C++ and Python together tests compare both bit for bit (tests/test_navfast.py, test_*_native_matches_*) bump the ABI number when a struct changes old .so is refused instead of crashing replace .so atomically (.tmp + mv) overwriting a loaded library crashes the running xgonav

PC: XGONAV_FASTLIB=navfast.so python -m pytest -q tests/ runs the OpenCV-free parts through C++ (Testing). Reference: Architecture.

docs.title: Simulator and tests
docs.text: Development happens on the PC. The simulator (xgonav/sim.py) renders a room by raycasting, with boxes, a walking person, pitch oscillation from real drives and motion blur. It is the only closed-loop validation. Reference: Testing.

docs.title: Tests
docs.text: Command What Time python -m pytest -q tests/ unit tests (C++ ones skipped without the core) ~2 s python -m pytest -q -m slow tests/ closed loop in the simulator ~10 min python -m pytest -q tests/test_units.py -k imu_sync one test

docs.title: Simulator runs
docs.text:
python tests/sim_run.py follow 40 out.mp4                         # follow, overlay video
python tests/sim_run.py follow 70 --scene zwei --wheels --dyn     # follow: person vanishes behind a wall, search at last position
python tests/sim_run.py explore 300 --wheels --fs-thread --dyn --rider --scene spalt
python tests/sim_run.py home 60 --wheels --dyn                    # 30 s explore, then home
python tests/sim_run.py pet 35 --wheels --imu --animal cat
Flag Effect --wheels simulated wheel odometry --dyn inertia like the balancing Rider (turn lag, dead band, roll-back) --rider Rider config values --imu simulated IMU (deliberately wrong sign and offset, sync must find them) --scene zwei\|spalt two rooms / 25 cm door --phantoms n false alarms of the floor model

Sim ≠ Rider

The simulator floor boundary is ground truth: FloorNet errors are not simulated. What works there can still stick at tight spots on the Rider.

docs.title: Replay real recordings
docs.text:
python -m xgonav --source video.mp4 --robot sim --mode follow --fast
python tools/replay_raw.py <recording> --config rider.toml --video out.mp4
python tools/map_replay.py <recording> --config rider.toml --out out/
